name: USA
summary: Visitor visa (B1/B2). Interview-based, so a well-prepared file matters most.
stay: Decided at the port of entry (commonly up to 6 months)
documents: Passport valid for your intended stay (6+ months recommended)
Recent photo that meets US specifications
Bank statements and income tax returns
Proof of ties to India (family, property, job)
Travel plan (avoid non-refundable tickets before approval)
notes: Most applicants must attend an interview in person.
attendance: Interview and fingerprints are attended in person.
feeDetails: Visa application (MRV) fee: US$185, non-refundable
A US$250 Visa Integrity Fee has been reported at some consular posts in 2026
Interview wait times vary widely by city
bestTime: Spring and autumn suit most cities
popularPlaces: New York, Los Angeles, Las Vegas, Orlando
tips: Book the interview slot early. Wait times vary by city and season.
Keep your answers short and consistent with your file.

name: UAE (Dubai)
summary: Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Our fastest: about 4 hours*.
route: Tourist e-visa, issued through a licensed sponsor
stay: 30, 60 or 90 days depending on visa type
documents: Passport valid 6+ months with 2 blank pages
Colour scan of the passport bio page
Recent passport photo on a white background
Hotel booking or host details in the UAE
Marriage certificate if your spouse’s name is not in the passport
notes: Overstay fines start from the first day after the visa expires (tightened in 2026).
Some travellers with valid US, UK or EU visas may qualify for visa on arrival. We check this for you.
governmentFee: About AED 252 to 285 (30 days, single entry)
feeDetails: The published government fee for a 30-day single-entry visa is about AED 252, plus 5% VAT
Amounts differ by emirate, channel and stay length
Longer stays and multiple entry cost more
bestTime: Nov to Mar for pleasant weather
tips: Hotel and return ticket must match your visa dates.
Keep a printed visa copy for hotel check-in.

name: Indonesia (Bali)
summary: Bali and beyond: e-VOA or visa on arrival, plus the arrival card and Bali levy.
documents: All Indonesia Arrival Card (free, within 72 hours before arrival)
Bali tourist levy of IDR 150,000 (for Bali only)
notes: The Visa on Arrival fee was IDR 500,000 when we checked.
feeDetails: Visa on Arrival fee was IDR 500,000 when we checked
Bali tourist levy: IDR 150,000
The All Indonesia Arrival Card is free
bestTime: Apr to Oct is the drier season in Bali
tips: Pay the Bali levy and save the arrival-card QR offline before boarding.
Carry proof of onward travel, as airlines check it.

name: Thailand
summary: Bangkok, Phuket and Pattaya. Visa-free for tourism, with a digital arrival card.
route: Visa-free tourism entry plus Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC)
documents: TDAC filed online, free, within 3 days before arrival
For stays over 30 days: Thai e-visa at thaievisa.go.th
notes: Thailand changed its rules several times in 2026. We re-check before you travel.
feeDetails: The Thailand Digital Arrival Card is free
A Thai e-visa for stays over 30 days has its own fee
bestTime: Nov to Feb is cooler and drier
tips: File the TDAC and keep the QR code handy.
Carry stay and funds proof, as officers may ask.

name: China
summary: Beijing, Shanghai and Guangzhou. Tourist (L) visa with careful document checks.
documents: Passport valid 6+ months with blank pages
Online application form on the official portal, approved at online review
Recent photo on a white background
Bank statements (the Mumbai centre cited a balance above ₹1,00,000 in Aug 2026)
Previous passport or Chinese visa copies, if any
notes: From 26 Oct 2026 the Chinese Embassy and Consulates accept applications directly, after an online review.
attendance: Fingerprints are taken in person at submission.
bestTime: Spring and autumn
tips: Match every date across forms, tickets and hotels.
Plan time for the in-person fingerprint step.

name: Saudi Arabia
summary: Tourism, business and pilgrimage travel. Your route depends on your travel history.
route: Tourist e-visa or visa on arrival if eligible, otherwise a visa through an authorised centre
documents: Passport valid 6+ months with 2 blank pages
Copy of a valid US, UK or Schengen visa (for the e-visa or arrival route)
notes: Eligibility for the e-visa or arrival route depends on your travel history. We confirm your route first.
attendance: The authorised-centre route may need biometrics.

popularPlaces: Riyadh, Jeddah, AlUla, Makkah and Madinah
tips: Check which route fits your travel history before paying.
Umrah and tourist visas follow different rules.

name: Vietnam
summary: Hanoi, Da Nang and Ho Chi Minh City. Our fastest: under 60 minutes*.
stay: e-visa valid up to 90 days, multiple entry
documents: Entry and exit points and stay details
Printed e-visa to carry at the airport
Return or onward ticket (carry for the airport)
notes: Phu Quoc Island: visa-free up to 30 days if you fly directly to the island and stay only there.
governmentFee: US$25 single entry, US$50 multiple entry
feeDetails: Official e-visa fee, valid up to 90 days
Fees are paid to the Vietnamese government and are generally non-refundable
bestTime: Feb to Apr and Sep to Nov are popular
popularPlaces: Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang, Phu Quoc
tips: Spell your name exactly as in the passport.
Print the e-visa and carry it for the airport.

feeDetails: The Malaysia Digital Arrival Card is free
